segmentName: Cold Rolling Mill Equipment (metal processing capital equipment)

market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates vary by scope: $6.35B (2023) to $8.82B by 2030 (4.8%/yr) for the machinery-specific definition; a narrower estimate puts it at $1.47B (2023) to $2.09B by 2030 (5.1%/yr); the broader 'cold rolling mill market' (incl. finished product) ranges $6.5-16.5B depending on source.
exportGeographies: Dubai (per Magadh Precision's own order/installation history)
globalCompetitors: Primetals Technologies — much larger, multinational, integrated plant-and-equipment suppliers, not directly scale-comparable to smaller Indian players
market.domesticSlice: China holds ~50% global share, India ~20%; Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region. India's crude steelmaking capacity is at ~222 MTPA (June 2026), targeting 300 MTPA by 2030 under the National Steel Policy — ~65 MT of additional capacity needed over the next five years, ~₹10 lakh crore of envisioned investment

structureFacts: Major steel-industry capex (SAIL, Tata Steel, JSW Steel, JSPL, AMNS) is the direct demand driver — e.g. Tata Steel's ₹3,200 Cr scrap-based EAF green steel plant at Ludhiana
Global leaders are investing heavily in Industry 4.0, ultra-thin-gauge and advanced-alloy rolling capability, raising the technology bar even for smaller regional suppliers

adoptionStructure.note: Long lead-time, large-ticket, project-based orders tied to steel industry capex cycles (new mill builds, capacity expansion, modernization/revamp) — inherently lumpy revenue recognition, not a repurchase-rate category

drivers: track record of successful commissioning and after-sales/spares support
reference installations (repeat business from steel mills)

steps: offer hot/cold rolling mills, pickling lines, metal coating lines, shearing/slitting lines
customize to client mill specifications and international standards
in-house design engineering (rolling mill process know-how)
maintain manufacturing/fabrication floor space and heavy-machining capacity
manage export-compliance/logistics for heavy equipment shipment
deliver commissioning support and after-sales/spares availability
win large-ticket, project-based orders tied to steel industry capex cycles
reorder on next capacity-expansion or modernization cycle
